parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for an exact match search by instance ID or instance name.

parameters.name: NeedDetailAttributes
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return detailed information. The default value is **false**.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
